title: Superscore Calculator
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Calculate an SAT or ACT superscore from several test dates and compare it with your best single-sitting score.

learningObjectives: Students will calculate an SAT or ACT superscore from multiple test dates and compare it with each single-sitting composite.
prerequisites: Chapter 6: The SAT and ACT Question

controls: Test-date name and section score inputs
Add test date and Remove last buttons
Load Emily and Load Casey buttons

keyQuestions: Why can a superscore be higher than any single test date?
Why does rounding sometimes erase a superscore gain on the ACT?
Why should you check each college's superscoring policy before you retest?
commonMisconceptions: A superscore always beats your best single sitting.
assessmentOpportunities: Students calculate a superscore from two or three test dates and compare it with the best single sitting.
